report.title: Orchestrating Autonomous Machine-to-Machine Intelligence: Task Decomposition, Delegation, and Context Management in Multi-Agent Systems
report.summary: The evolution of multi-agent systems (MAS) has progressed from monolithic, pre-programmed architectures to highly dynamic, autonomous machine-to-machine (MATM) environments. In these ecosystems, software agents must independently discover capabilities, establish trust, decompose complex objectives,…
